slides.heading: Get checked promptly if you notice

caption:
Hay fever season, one big sneeze, and suddenly Mr Turtle's back has locked up.

A sneeze is a fast, forceful squeeze of your trunk muscles, often while you're slightly bent or twisted. If your back is already tired from long sitting, poor sleep or a busy week, that sudden load can set off a spasm.

Early on, gentle movement, short walks and heat often help, and most acute back pain settles over days to a few weeks. Next time, stand tall with soft knees and a hand on a wall.

Leg numbness or weakness, saddle numbness or bladder changes need prompt medical attention. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.
